title: Dragon Roar.wav
author: Dreeme
description: Something i threw together for a personal project i was working on. I couldn't find any high quality samples of a Dragon so i decided to make my own. This was created using Ableton and contains the following sounds: A Dog Growling A lion Roar A Horse Grunting An Elephant Vocalising A Flamethrower Sound All sounds used were obtained from Royalty Free websites and manipulated using software so that the original samples are not identifiable. The combining, layering and processing of the sounds were all done by myself within my DAW. I hope those of you who find this are able to make great use of it. Feel free to link me to projects you may use this in!
